         1                 P R O C E E D I N G S

         2                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

         3       The Senate will please come to order.

         4                  I ask everyone present to rise and

         5       recite with me the Pledge of Allegiance to our

         6       Flag.

         7                  (Whereupon, the assemblage recited

         8       the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

         9                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        10       In the absence of clergy, may we all bow our

        11       heads for a moment of silence.

        12                  (Whereupon, the assemblage

        13       respected a moment of silence.)

        14                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        15       Thank you.

        16                  Senator Smith, I have at the desk

        17       here a proclamation which I'm handing down to

        18       the Secretary at this time.

        19                  SENATOR SMITH:    Read the

        20       proclamation, please.

        21                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        22       The Secretary will read.

        23                  THE SECRETARY:    "Pursuant to the

        24       power vested in me by Article IV, Section 3 of



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         5438



         1       the Constitution, I hereby convene the Senate

         2       of the State of New York in Extraordinary

         3       Session at the Capitol, in the City of Albany,

         4       on the twenty-fifth day of June, two

         5       thousand nine, at three o'clock, for the

         6       purpose of considering legislation that

         7       nominations I will submit with respect to

         8       various subjects, and for the consideration of

         9       legislation with respect to such other

        10       subjects as I may recommend.

        11                  "Given under my hand and the privy

        12       seal of the State, in the City of Albany, this

        13       twenty-fourth day of June in the year

        14       two thousand nine, by the Governor, David A.

        15       Paterson."

        16                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        17       The proclamation having been read, the session

        18       is in an extraordinary session.

        19                  Before we go on, Senator Smith, I'd

        20       like to recognize Senator Craig Johnson for a

        21       moment.

        22                  SENATOR CRAIG JOHNSON:    Thank you

        23       very much, Madam President.

        24                  I just want to recognize that today



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         5439



         1       happens to be the 15th yahrtzeit, the

         2       anniversary of the death of Rabbi Menachem

         3       Schneerson.

         4                  For those of you who may not know,

         5       the Rebbe, Rabbi Schneerson, was one of the

         6       greatest spiritual leaders over the past

         7       century.  And one of the important things that

         8       the Rebbe taught was about bringing goodness

         9       and kindness to all people throughout the

        10       world.

        11                  And I think, as we see these days

        12       here in Albany and all across our great state,

        13       if we can just take a moment of silence for

        14       prayers for him and his family and to take in

        15       the words that he taught and taught so many.

        16       So if I could just ask for people to rise for

        17       that moment of silence for the Rebbe, I would

        18       appreciate it.

        19                  (Whereupon, the assemblage

        20       respected a moment of silence.)

        21                  SENATOR CRAIG JOHNSON:    Thank

        22       you, Madam President.

        23                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        24       Senator Smith.



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1                  SENATOR SMITH:    Yes, Madam

         2       President.  Thank you for recognizing our

         3       colleague Senator Craig Johnson for that brief

         4       statement which is so important to us.

         5                  But, Madam President, in light of

         6       the fact that the Governor has still neglected

         7       to bring the Assembly into Extraordinary

         8       Session Number 3 with us, I have to move that

         9       we do not take up any legislative activity

        10       today and we adjourn the special session

        11       sine die.

        12                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        13       Thank you, Senator Smith.  On motion, this

        14       third extraordinary session is adjourned

        15       sine die.

        16                  (Whereupon, at 3:09 p.m., the

        17       Senate adjourned.)
